digest.greeting: Good morning, Jean. Friday, September 18 has six live meetings and one protected focus block, with eight carried-over actions and four marked urgent. Today’s priorities are moving the approved Amazon Connect Wave 1 rollout into execution, sharpening the EOW and executive status readout, and using the 4:00 PM scoping call to set the path for the new intake. The main risk is still Amazon Connect: the Denver pilot sequence and deployment dates need confirmation, while SaltClick has no estimate or agreed support scope for Phase II follow-up. Dashboard completion state was last modified Friday, September 11, so carry-over status may be stale.

items.label: Move the approved Amazon Connect Wave 1 launch into execution
items.detail: Use the 10:30 AM standup to review the Project Plan-Prod deployment dates, confirm Denver’s initial users and office sequence, and close the remaining mitigations before the September 22 pilot. Current information points to Patty Marquez and Juan Gonzalez as the two Denver users, while Matt is validating the remaining Wave 1 sequence.

items.label: Lock Amazon Connect production ownership and support
items.detail: Confirm the dedicated Salesforce integration account and the internal support model. SaltClick has not committed timing or scope for Phase II follow-up, leaving production support and added-spend exposure unresolved.

items.label: Set the Amazon Connect training mitigation
items.detail: Confirm ownership for hands-on sessions, site champions, morning test calls, and the Monday/Wednesday/Friday completion cadence before Wave 1 begins.

items.label: Set the CoE backlog and intake path for Sprint 19
items.detail: Use today’s pipeline discussion to confirm the backlog with Jill and settle the remaining classification question for Timetrack of Stage Completion, which is still pending an IT effort review.

items.label: Protect the Attorney Review at Intake plan while Jhara is out
items.detail: Jhara is out today and the project has an October 15 deadline. Confirm coverage for any immediate dependency, then use Monday’s Legal Request Tool feedback session to reconnect scope, milestones, and ownership.

items.detail: Confirm the affected project and severity, then assign remediation or document why no immediate action is required.

items.label: Clear the overdue Rippling task

items.label: Clear the pending access approvals
